translated_text: Hello lady! + I wish you all the best for your short trip. Thank you so much for everything. Unfortunately, various authors didn't want us to see each other on your trip. Nevertheless, I will try to do fruitful work for you. 7. Last night. Yours, Bob. And I received the approval for the plane ticket. I have Peats, Haugh & Art from that, depending on whether I have Peats. So I'll definitely come to Pemptens. Yours, Rob. p. 1.38 Zabuz, your letter finally arrived last night. I can't understand, though, why I didn't receive any mail for 10 days. Besides, I always wrote immediately when I knew something definite. = Little one, I won't complain anymore, but if this continues, I'm ready for a sanatorium. It's a shame that so much valuable energy is wasted. The 3-day journey didn't bother me at all. I still need three visas: Hungary, Yugoslavia, and Switzerland. The Ingosta visa was rejected yesterday. I have to submit my application in Belgrade, and that takes time. But in my desperation, I contacted the Foreign Ministry again. Dr. From called today. I was informed he's back. I went there immediately, spoke with his representative, had a follow-up phone call, and now I'm sitting downstairs in the Foreign Ministry waiting for the letter they'll give me for the National Bank. So I'll make another attempt to get the plane ticket approved! You'll only be able to fully grasp all of this when I tell you everything in person. It couldn't be more complicated. What you know is at most 10% of it. I'm driving myself crazy. Do you know how happy I would be if I could put all of this behind me?!!! You can be sure that I'm doing everything I can. I'm sure I've made mistakes too, but if one knew everything beforehand... personally. Regarding that, the telegram I sent has of course become irrelevant due to the letter and my visit today. Little one, please don't be impatient, I'm already impatient enough. Yours truly.
